evidence_candidates.excerpt: The UCIe Consortium describes an open package-level die-to-die interconnect and software stack. UCIe 3.0 adds 48 and 64 GT/s rates, system-level manageability, power-saving features, and backward compatibility for interoperable multi-chip systems.
evidence_candidates.statement_supported: CXL and UCIe standards are extending open interconnects for higher-bandwidth heterogeneous memory, compute and multi-chiplet systems while retaining interoperability mechanisms.
